en.bdb: The tree bears the evil and does the good
With the help of iron the tree is cut and pruned and iron nails are stuck into it.
But the tree carry iron on its head keeps it floating on water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਾਲਿ ਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aapanaRaa put paal na neer ddubaiaa|

en.bdb: The water also considering it its adopted son does not make it sink.
But the sandalwood is sunk intentionally to make it costlier.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਇ ਜਗੁ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gun keete gun hoi jag pateeaaiaa|

en.bdb: The quality of goodness produces goodness and the whole world also remains happy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਹਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit_en: avagun seh gun karai ghol ghumaiaa ||12||

en.bdb: I am sacrifice unto him who does good in return of evil.
